content: My lower back hurts after deadlifts, should I keep going?

⚠️ Don't push through it. Stop deadlifting while it hurts. Lower back pain after pulling is a signal to drop the load or pause the lift. If the pain is sharp, lasts more than a few days, or comes with numbness or tingling in your legs, see a doctor or physio. I can't diagnose it.

💡 Once it's pain-free, come back lighter and check your form. Keep the bar close, brace your core, and keep your back neutral instead of rounded. Add weight slowly after that.
